content:
Chapter 329 I Want A Single Challenge

A powerful person who breaks the Taoist realm!

"Class leader!"

Seeing the sudden appearance of the powerful person in the Dao Breaking Realm, the Wutuo tribe looked very happy.

The visitor is the strongest person of their Wutuo clan and the leader of the Wutuo clan.

But at this moment, the leader of the Wutuo clan stared at Lu Xue in the distance with a serious expression.

"I didn't expect that it would be fine if your father was shameless, but you were so shameless."

Lu Xue:?

"What's the meaning?"

Lu Xue frowned.

Suddenly I mentioned what my father was doing.

Could it be that this guy in front of me still knows his father?

At this time, the head of the Wutuo clan said in a deep voice: "Your father took advantage of my retreat to destroy my clan and seize the luck of the Wutuo clan."

"Now, it's fine if your father doesn't come forward, but as his daughter, you are still called a man. Isn't this shameless?!"

Hearing this, Lu Xue was speechless.

You really dare to say it when your father comes forward.

The other strong men in Huangcheng also looked at the leader of the Wutuo clan like a fool.

Where did this come from 2b? Can you be the leader of the Wutuo clan?

At this time, the leader of the Wutuo clan looked at Lu Xue and said angrily: "Call your father out, I want to fight him one-on-one!"

The words of the leader of the Wutuo clan kept echoing in the void of the Wutuo clan.

Everyone stopped without exception.

Everyone in Huangcheng looked at the Wutuo tribe leader in the distance with disbelief, his eyelids twitching wildly.

They swear that this is the bravest person they have ever met in so many years.

A one-on-one fight with the city lord? !

Looking at everyone, the leader of the Wutuo tribe sneered, "What, don't you dare to come out?"

It seems that he guessed well. That guy may indeed be a bit powerful, but not much, which means he can scare people. If he was really that strong, how could he have hiding until now? Otherwise, he would have come out to destroy their Wutuo long ago. Are you a clan?

So now, as long as he controls that guy, the Tawutuo tribe will still have a chance.

And at this moment, an indescribable aura suddenly came from the surrounding space without warning.

At this moment, time and space seemed to stop flowing.

Buzz —

The space in the distance suddenly spread like a tide.

That's right, it's not that it was forcibly torn apart, but that it automatically dispersed around like welcoming an existence.

Immediately afterwards, a crisp sound of footsteps rang out, echoing in everyone's ears.

At this moment, the needle fell in the field and everyone stared at that direction.

"well."

A sigh sounded softly.

Some people could no longer stand this aura and fainted.

At this time, the figure of that person finally appeared in everyone's eyes.

He still had the same calm face, as if everything was firmly under his control.

"We've seen the city lord!"

Everyone present in Huangcheng did not hesitate at all and worshiped Lu Daosheng respectfully.

Seeing this scene, the rest of the people's hearts were beating wildly.

City Lord?

These mysterious powerful men are actually this man.

And this person is actually Lu Xue's father.

For a moment, the strong people in the fairy world were extremely complicated.

The leader of the Wutuo clan seemed to realize something, and he was extremely nervous.

It seems that I have made some mistakes in my judgment.

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked at him.

In an instant, his mind trembled. The other party just looked at him, and he couldn't move to save himself.

It's over.

This was the last thought in his mind.

"You want to fight me?"

Lu Daosheng looked at the leader of the Wutuo tribe in the distance and said with a smile.

At this moment, the leader of the Wutuo clan opened his mouth, but couldn't say anything.

When he faced Lu Daosheng before, he was just a clone. Now, when he faced Lu Daosheng, he deeply felt the horror of Lu Daosheng.

In front of Lu Daosheng, he couldn't even have the slightest idea of resistance.

Looking at the leader of the Wutuo clan who was already scared in front of him, Lu Daosheng shook his head with a little disappointed.

"weak."

With a gentle wave, the next moment, under the fearful gaze of the Wutuo tribe, the Wutuo tribe leader began to slowly dissipate.

It's directly erased!

No minute or a tiny left.

At this moment, everyone in the Wutuo tribe dared not show off.

However, what they didn't know was that from the moment their Wutuo tribe attacked Lu Xue, the fate of their Wutuo tribe being exterminated was already destined.

"The Wutuo clan has no need to exist."

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, the hearts of the Wutuo tribe suddenly fell to the bottom.

The man in front of him did not have to let them go.

That's the case.

"Wait a moment!"

A powerful man from the Wutuo tribe in the palm of the Dao Realm suddenly spoke.

Lu Daosheng looked at the Wutuo people.

"Since you want to destroy the Wowutuo clan, you have to see if the ancestor of the Wowutuo clan agrees."

The Wutuo tribe member gritted his teeth.

"Call the ancestors!"

A angrily shout.

The next moment, a terrifying aura surged out from the depths of the Wutuo tribe.

Immediately afterwards, an old man's phantom slowly emerged above the Wutuo tribe.

Seeing this phantom, even the strong men in Huangcheng couldn't help but be a little surprised.

The Wutuo tribe actually has such a trump card.

But it’s a pity that he is facing their city lord.

I saw that the old man's eyes were turbid and his expression was a little confused, but soon, he returned to the clarity.

After seeing the situation clearly, he couldn't help but sigh slightly.

"Although I guessed that the Wutuo clan would have such a disaster, I didn't expect it to be so fast."

"But, although the Wowutuo tribe has declined, not everyone can destroy it."

The old man's words changed, and a terrifying aura surged out of his body again.

At this moment, even the sky has changed.

Feeling the horror of his ancestor, the Wutuo tribe looked excited.

"Old ancestor, kill him and avenge the clan leader!"

"Avenge the clan leader!"

The silent heart of the Wutuo tribe boiled again at this moment.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng shook his head slightly.

"Guess, why didn't your patriarch call his ancestor?"

Upon hearing this, the Zhongwutuo people were slightly stunned.

At this time, Lu Daosheng told them the answer.

Lu Daosheng raised his hand and under the horrified gaze of the people of Zhongwutuo tribe, the figure of the ancestor of the Wutuo tribe suddenly dissipated with the wind.

Before leaving, the last voice of the ancestor of the Wutuo clan sounded from the scene.

"Unworthy descendants! I'm still trying to kill you when I'm dead,"

I haven't finished speaking, but the meaning is clear.

At this moment, a strong sense of despair continued to spread among the Wutuo tribe.

"it's all over."

Lu Daosheng raised his hand slightly.

All the strong men brought by Lu Xue, including Lu Xue, were all taken to the world in the palm of his hand by Lu Daosheng.

Then, Lu Daosheng stretched out his right palm and pressed it downwards.

Suddenly, the entire Wutuo tribe continent began to become illusory.

A moment later, the Wutuo tribe continent disappeared into this world forever, and along with it, the entire Wutuo tribe was also included.
